Hi Diane,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great context on the inference-heavy batch jobs and your latency-sensitive alerting use cases. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused architecture review that covers: 1) service patterns for mixed realtime/batch traffic, 2) SLO targets and graceful-degradation strategies, and 3) network/data flow expectations for private deployments.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Oct 5: 10:00–11:15am PT (18:00–19:15 CEST)
- Wed Oct 6: 8:30–9:45am PT
- Thu Oct 7: 2:00–3:15pm PT

Please tell us which slot works best and who from your side will join (I see you + Ravi from discovery; if you have a security/network engineer, please include them). We plan for ~75 minutes: ~20m context, ~30m architecture walkthrough, ~20m Q&A/action items.

I've attached a short runbook that outlines the topics we'll cover and a stub checklist for network info we typically request — it will help us be efficient. If you can share a simple network diagram or any constraints (VPC peering, private endpoints, egress rules) before the meeting, that would be ideal.

Ben (pre-sales engineer) and Karthik (solutions lead) are copied — they'll lead the walkthrough.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
